Design and implement multi-step AI Agents using agentic frameworks(LangGraph, OpenAI SDK/Swarm, Google ADK, etc.).Architect robust workflows for agents that interact with browser automation, APIs, LLMs, PDFs, and CRMs.Optimize latency, cost, and performance across the agent lifecycle.Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate agents into our core platform.Create strong observability and debugging tools to ensure agent performance and accountability.Handle prompt engineering, function-calling, memory, tool creation, and multi-agent orchestration.Stay on the frontier of agent research and apply new findings pragmatically.You Might Be a Fit If:
You’ve shipped agent-based systems that go beyond chat UX—e.G., agents that fill forms, move through websites, analyze documents, or trigger downstream workflows.You’re fluent in one or more of the agentic frameworks:
LangGraph, SmolAgent, OpenAI SDK, Google ADK, CrewAI, etc.You are an excellent backend engineer who codes daily and owns systems end to end.You’re obsessive about reliability, debuggability, and ensuring AI systems behave deterministically when needed.You’ve worked with LLMs via API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Claude, Mistral, or fine-tuned models).You understand when to use LLMs vs deterministic logic and how to blend both.You’re deeply organized, low ego, and can lead through action and collaboration.You care about product and user value just as much as the tech stack.Bonus Points:
Experience with RPA, Selenium, or building automation bots for web workflows.Background in insurance, fintech, or other compliance-heavy verticals. Contributions to open-source agentic frameworks or related tooling.Knowledge of DevOps and production monitoring for AI services.What We Offer:
Collaborative and innovative work environmentFlex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.Personal laptop.Health and wellness package.Budget for English lessons.Why Join XILO?You’ll be on the ground floor of a rapidly growing AI startup building AI agents that replace jobs, not just enhance them. You’ll solve real business problems, help agents generate revenue and reduce service costs, and leave your fingerprint on the core intelligence of our product.We’re a mission-driven team that works hard, moves fast, and doesn’t stop until the job is done right. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career, we want to hear from you.Apply only if you’re ready to build AI that does the job—not just chat about it.

We Always do the Right Thing. Who we’re looking for:
We seek an executive-level technology leader who is visionary, strategic, and passionate about innovation - without needing to be hands-on in coding. As a CTO/Head of Engineering, you will guide our tech and product strategy, ensuring alignment with business goals and fostering a culture of growth and servant leadership. This is a hybrid role combining strategic leadership with hands-on involvement. Approximately 25–30% of the time will be dedicated to implementation and debugging, while the remaining focus will be on system architecture, technical direction, and guiding internal teams. Work directly with external vendors and partners to align on expectations and drive outcomes—this role does not involve formal vendor management but requires effective collaboration to ensure delivery meets our standards.Why this role is unique:
We are transitioning from in-house backend development to a third-party tech provider to enhance scalability, security, and performance while reducing bugs and maintenance overhead. This is a strategic shift that allows us to focus on front-end improvements, marketing experiments, and product innovation. We need a leader excited about this transformation - someone who can refine product strategy, guide teams, and drive innovation rather than push for in-house backend development.As a CTO/Head of Engineering, you will be responsible for:
Technology & Product Strategy – Define and execute a long-term technology roadmap aligned with business goals and innovation. Leadership & Growth – Inspire, mentor, and empower teams to drive effective execution.Product Ownership & Execution – Oversee product evolution, ensuring front-end and API development supports user experience, marketing agility, and growth initiatives. Security & Scalability – Ensure site security, performance, and scalability by working with our third-party technology partner while keeping internal processes efficient. Technical Escalation & Support – Provide backup for critical issues and guide troubleshooting, ensuring smooth collaboration with third-party providers.Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with marketing, sales, and operations to leverage technology for business impact. Vendor & Partner Management – Manage relationships with external tech providers to maximize efficiency, reliability, and innovation.You’ll thrive in this role if you are:
A visionary and servant leader who inspires teams and drives strategy. Product-driven with business acumen, focusing on strategic impact rather than just technical execution. Excited about transitioning to a third-party provider, focusing on innovation, scalability, and growth. Technical but not hands-on daily, guiding decisions without coding every day. Adaptable, proactive, and resourceful in navigating complex challenges. A tech enthusiast passionate about AI and emerging technologies. A strong communicator who can explain complex concepts to non-experts. Remote-ready and thrive in a flexible, independent work environment.Must-Have Experience Leadership experience in a technology or product-focused executive role Experience with Client side web development (HTML/CSS/JS/Smarty/Smarty Twig) Deep understanding of front-end and API-driven development (modern JavaScript frameworks (e.G., React, AngularJS), CSS frameworks (e.G., Bootstrap, Foundation, UI Kit), component-based architecture, GraphQL) Understanding of AWS, CDN, MariaDB, Apache HTTPd web servers, Linux, Cloud computing, CI/CD, cybersecurityExperience working with Platform as a Service (PaaS) and API-driven environments Security and scalability expertise in a digital product environment Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage external technology vendors Experience collaborating with external vendors to drive outcomes without direct management responsibility.Nice to Have (or willingness to learn) Cloudflare (maintenance, security, performance optimization) WordPress, PHP, MySQL GTM, on-site data tracking, SEO Experience with automation tools, AI-driven tech, and experimentation platforms (e.G., VWO) UX/UI familiarity (Figma, Adobe XD) What This Role is NOT A hands-on backend developer role.A position for someone looking to rebuild everything in-house.A rigid environment - our culture values adaptability, collaboration, and strategic thinking.Additional Information:
This role is full-time, requiring 35-40 hours per week.It is a fully remote contract position, with Independent Contractors responsible for their taxes and benefits. Each applicant is required to successfully complete a paid Trial Period before transitioning to this role. If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications but believe you will be a great fit, you should still seriously consider applying. Ready to apply?If you share our values and enthusiasm for empowering the world, please send a resume and a short cover letter with a brief description of where you see yourself adding value to the team to Please address your cover letter to Helen.SaveaLife.Com does not discriminate based on sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, race, ethnicity, age, religion, or economic background. Further, we strongly encourage individuals from traditionally underrepresented identities to apply, including identities not explicitly named above. If there are any considerations or qualifications not acknowledged in our job description that you feel are important and relevant to this position, we encourage you to bring them to light in your application.

title: Senior 3d Frontend Developer
description:
Formify:
where imagination becomes live and interactive! We're on a mission to revolutionize the world of 3D visualization software with our cutting-edge, web-based platform that brings products, cabinetry, and customized apartments to life in real-time.At Formify, we're not just creating a SaaS product, we are optimizing the users experience by redefining how people experience and interact with 3D visualizations. Our live rendering technology takes you on a journey into a world where creativity knows no bounds. Whether you're a seasoned designer, a tech enthusiast, or someone who simply appreciates the beauty of customization, we have a place for you on our team.We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior 3D Frontend Developer to join our passionate team on an initial 12 month contract. As a Senior 3D Frontend Developer at Formify, you will play a key role in shaping the user interface and overall user experience of our platform. This position will be hired primarily on a remote contractor basis.Roles and Responsibilities:
Collaborate with product managers, UX/UI designers, and backend developers to implement visually appealing and intuitive user interfaces.Creating the 3D preview and architecture of the Next.Js / Three.Js application.Translate design wireframes and prototypes into high-quality, responsive web applications.Develop and maintain reusable code components and libraries for future use.Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and best practices to continuously enhance our frontend development processes.Troubleshoot and debug issues, ensuring a seamless user experience across various browsers and devices.Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.A degree specialising in, or experience with Computer Graphics would be an advantage.5+ years proven experience as a Frontend Developer, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work.Experience with Object Oriented Programming.Experience implementing 3D assets in frontend environments and optimising for performance.Proficiency in JavaScript, Typescript and modern frontend frameworks (e.G., React, Angular, Vue.Js).Experience with RESTful APIs and integration of third-party libraries.Strong understanding of UI/UX principles and best practices.Familiarity with version control systems (e.G., Git).Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.Solution-oriented thinker who thrives working in a fast-paced, agile environment.Can work on own initiative;
self-motivated with strong follow-through.Has a start-up mindset, must be excited about our vision and eager to be a key player in the growth of our business.Why join us at Formify?Innovation at its Core:
We're not following trends;
we're setting them. Ourteam is driven by an insatiable curiosity and a passion for pushing the boundaries of what's possible in 3D visualization.Endless Creative Opportunities:
Imagine being part of a company where your work allows users to create, customize, and visualize their dream apartments, furniture, and more in real-time. Your contribution will be at the forefront of making dreams a reality.Collaboration and Growth:
We foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated. You'll work with a talented team of like-minded professionals who are committed to pushing the limits of technology:
interacting daily with C level executives.Impact:
Your work will have a real-world impact on industries like interior design, architecture, and e-commerce. You'll be contributing to the tools that help our clients bring their ideas to life.Continuous Learning:
In a fast-paced, ever-evolving industry, we believe in continuous learning and development. You'll have access to resources and opportunities to keep your skills sharp and your knowledge up-to-date.Flexibility:
We understand that life is not just about work. We offer flexible working arrangements.If you're a visionary, a dreamer, a creative thinker, or a tech wizard with a passion for transforming the way people visualize and create, we want you on our team. Join us at Formify and let's shape the future of 3D visualization together. Your journey starts here.Formify is an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive working environment. We encourage all interested applicants to reach out, regardless of whether their experience matches perfectly, their background, and other factors protected by law.
